exposure: Disruption between desired and actual delivery mode
cohort: The study included 57 postpartum women from three public maternity hospitals in Brazil.
finding: The study found a severe Fear of Childbirth prevalence of 10.6% and that disruption between desired and actual delivery mode might be associated with FoC occurrence.
mod_finding: Disruption between desired and actual delivery mode was associated with Fear of Childbirth occurrence.
